basic_info.description: Welcome to The Palace at Washington Square-a rare opportunity to own a modern North Beach condominium in one of San Francisco's most iconic locations. Designed by renowned architect Robert Rudeen and completed in 2018, this boutique building blends classic design with contemporary comfort. The 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom home features Thermador appliances, spacious bathrooms with radiant heated floors, one-car parking, and elevator access. The expansive exclusive-use wraparound terrace-one of the largest in the building-is a true standout, offering views of Saints Peter and Paul Church and an ideal space for indoor-outdoor living. Amenities include a shared rooftop deck with sweeping views of Coit Tower and the downtown skyline, plus a fitness center. With a perfect 100 Walk Score, you are moments away from Washington Square Park, Chinatown, and North Beach's best cafes, restaurants, and bakeries. This is San Francisco living at its best-boutique, iconic, and rarely available.
